description: The destinations section (default null = names nothing) — scoped-selection rows layered over exactly one References row each (see WorldDestination), echoed by world.destinations. A WorldPlacementPortal facet's Destination resolves against this section, not References directly. No boot-time file-existence check; resolution is a consumer's job. Optional, for the same reason Rules is. boot-only like References/ Portals — no live mutation arm yet.

items.description: One row of the destinations section — scoped selection layered over exactly one WorldReference row (docs/vision.md, "Reference, destination and session are different facts"). A WorldReference names a document; a destination decides how an instance of that document is minted and reused. Several destinations may select one reference differently — a fresh group dungeon, a persisted user workshop, and a shared global zone can all point at the same document.

name.description: The destination's own name — WorldSafeName-shaped, unique within the section. A Destination facet resolves against this name (see WorldDefinitionValidator).

reference.description: The Name of the references row this destination selects. Must resolve to an existing row — an undeclared name refuses by name. Never repeats Document itself: several destinations may select one reference differently.

durability.description: How this destination's target instance is minted (see WorldDestinationDurability).

scope.description: Which scoped identity/generation this destination selects (see WorldDestinationScope). Absent resolves to Global — today's behavior, unchanged for every row authored before this member existed. Trailing member: the same widen-without-moving-existing-members shape WorldWaterSection's own remarks describe.

selector.description: Which group a Group row resolves through (see WorldGroupSelector). Required exactly when Scope is Group — a selector on any other scope, or a group scope with none, refuses by name (see WorldDefinitionValidator).

anyOf.description: Assigns the destination to exactly one authored group — every traveler must prove membership in Group specifically.

group.description: The Id this destination is bound to. Must resolve to a declared group row — an undeclared id refuses by name.

anyOf.description: Selects the traveler's unique verified membership claim carrying Tag — zero matching memberships and multiple matching memberships are distinct named refusals; the engine never picks one silently (see Tags).

tag.description: The tag every candidate membership is matched against. Must be non-empty.
